(3) A man wearing an orange and yellow dinosaur-themed onesie stands in a different part of the room, looking confused. (4) The woman uses the tissue to remove her eye makeup, pulling the skin around her eyes as she wipes. (5) The man in the onesie moves frantically, throwing his arms up and jumping in the background of a bedroom near a dresser. (6) The woman ties her long hair into a high bun, revealing a face with significantly less makeup. (7) The man stands with his hands on his hips, looking at the woman with an expression of disbelief. (8) The woman throws her hands up in an exasperated gesture, her hair now fully tied back.
